payload.title: feat/record cca1c2e9aa5c: the record on refs/hyp/record, a colon folder imported by PATH, a forced untrack and every program start found
payload.body: Commit cca1c2e9aa5c on feat/record over 6e298332bcb4 (h-record-11). An argument of hyp import that names a folder on disk is a PATH, also when it holds a colon (limit R-WX9YBH#1); hyp import untracks an unnamed evidence file with git rm --cached --force, so staged bytes that differ from HEAD and the work tree do not stop it (limit R-WX9YBH#2); the boundary scan flags a dot import of os or syscall, syscall's raw system calls and execve numbers, and every golang.org/x/sys import (limit R-WX9YBH#3). It meets every line of G-SZCBXZ.

why: The successor of h-record-11 that closes its limits.
h-record-12 is h-record-11 with a fix for each of its limits.
The candidate is this commit; its tests and the Experiments run at it.

payload.title: Gate of h-record-12: new tests red on the stand-in and green, removal checks, go test, import check, review
payload.body:
Gate of h-record-12: commit cca1c2e9aa5c on feat/record over 6e298332bcb4 (h-record-11). Runs the case of every line G-SZCBXZ#1-#10 and of limits R-WX9YBH#1-#3. Decided by reading the logs in this evidence folder.
1. New tests, run on the stand-in 6e298332bcb4 before this Experiment, each added alone (standin-*.txt): TestImportStoreFolderWithAColon (#8, R-WX9YBH#1), TestImportUntracksAnUnnamedFileWithStagedChanges (#6, R-WX9YBH#2) and TestBoundaryFindsEveryProgramStart (#10, R-WX9YBH#3) red. On the candidate all green, and every new and line test of E-BTM3WF (the line-10 test fails with the probe).
2. Removals, each alone: the patch applies whole, then the named test fails on an assertion; a build failure or a pass is a failed removal. r1-r30 as E-BTM3WF names them; r31 TestImportStoreFolderWithAColon; r32 TestImportUntracksAnUnnamedFileWithStagedChanges; r33 TestBoundaryFindsEveryProgramStart.
3. go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 exit 0 at the candidate.
4. Import check: as E-KCSN9Y step 4, at the candidate, in a sandbox clone at main afe2c1f.
5. Answers R-8ZKFQV#r1, R-BHDBGK#r1, R-EK3R0H#r1 and R-V2CMZQ#r1 are applied: the out-of-Goal review tests of E-FWBCRZ and the strict check TestReviewShowBundleEvidenceAfterSync of E-82GHK7 run at the candidate and set no verdict; by R-V2CMZQ#r1 that check is out-of-Goal for line 1, so no reading is copied.
6. Review: one fresh subagent reviews git show cca1c2e9aa5c with the brief of E-BTM3WF but that commit and the answer R-V2CMZQ#r1 added to its settled keys; it returns each finding as a test with its output. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the candidate contradicts h-record-12.
Verdict: supports when 1-6 hold; else contradicts.

why: The gate of h-record-12, its rubric fixed before any gate run.

payload.observation: Gate of cca1c2e9aa5c: the three new tests (colon store folder, staged unnamed file, every program start) are red on 6e298332bcb4 and green here; every earlier new and line test stays green; the line-10 test fails with the probe. Removals r1-r33 (r8b for r8) apply whole and fail their test on an assertion. go vet and go test ./... pass. Import check: renders equal, second import adds nothing. Review: TestReviewStoreFolderEnteredWithOtherCase (#1) and TestReviewImportKeepsBytesNoEventNames (#8) are red.
limits: On a case-insensitive filesystem, a store folder entered with other letter case, such as S for s: hyp status and hyp show there, and a write from there, read and write the store s.
hyp import of a work-tree store whose event names a file whose bytes on disk changed after the event and no longer hash as the event stores.

why: The gate of h-record-12 holds; returned tests that are cases of lines 1 and 8 are red.
